d.ko:
A first person social deduction game, combining real time action and communication, playable up to 16 players.

While most players will cooperate to complete objectives to ensure victory, a small portion of dissidents will try their best to stop them at all cost, without being caught.

一款第一人称社交推理游戏，结合了实时动作与交流，可支持最多16名玩家同时游玩。

大多数玩家将合作完成目标以取得胜利，而少部分叛徒则会竭尽全力阻止他们的计划，同时避免暴露身份。
